text:
alex: Heads-up — nightly traffic replay (k6 -> locust path) had 2 worker exits during the 20m ramp at ~20:12 PT. Locust master stayed up but we lost ~35% of virtual users. Logs uploaded: s3://redwood-test-artifacts/replays/1804442100/logs.tar.gz :eyes:

maria: ack. any OOMs in the worker logs? or connection resets?

alex: quick grep shows a segfault in one worker and `MemoryError` in another. snippet: ```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/locust/worker.py", line 214, in run
    client.do_request()
MemoryError: unable to allocate 512 MiB
```

zhang: hmm, we recently bumped per-worker batch_size to 128 for throughput. Could be the change. Also saw some kv-cache growth in traces.

ryan: pinging ci-bot for the run config and machine sizes. @ci-bot can you paste the job meta?

ci-bot: job_id=nightly-replay-2026-03-17-20, image=redwood/locust:stable-202603, workers=15, instance_type=g4dn.xlarge (16GB RAM), batch_size=128, replay_window=30m, heap_profile=true

maria: g4dn.xlarge has ~16GB but system overhead + models being probed could push workers close. With batch_size=128 each worker spikes mem during bursts. Can we try batch_size=64 for next run? Also enable `--mem-limit` in locust wrapper?

alex: agree. plan: rerun a shorter 1h replay with batch_size=64 and heap snapshots every 10m. I'll also toggle prefix/KV cache off for the run to rule that out. Command I will use: ```
./run_replay.sh --mode k6-locust --workers 15 --batch 64 --replay-window 1h --kv-cache off --heap-snap 10m
```

zhang: also add `--max-concurrency 1200` to avoid per-worker request burst causing mem spikes.

ryan: schedule? I can kick it off in the 22:00 PT slot if that works for everyone.

alex: 22:00 PT works. tagging @maria to watch heap diffs and @zhang for kernel side checks. I'll post the new run id and logs.

maria: I'll set up an automated diff script to compare heap snapshots and upload flamegraphs to the same s3 path. If we still see segfaults, we'll capture core dumps.

zhang: if it's reproducible, we should also try one worker on a c5a.large with more memory headroom to isolate infra vs code.

alex: good call. I'll reserve one machine as an isolation run.

ryan: I'll update the soak board with the action items and owner links. Owners: alex (rerun + logs), maria (heap diffs), zhang (infra isolation), ryan (scheduling + board).

alex: thanks — will post results in this thread once available. :thumbsup:

maria: quick note: if we don't see mem growth after batch_size drop, we should file a follow-up to revert batch_size bump in prod-configs.

ci-bot: rerun scheduled: nightly-replay-2026-03-17-22 (ETA 22:00 PT). artifacts prefix: s3://redwood-test-artifacts/replays/1804442100-rerun/

alex: closing for now, will reopen if any novel failures show up.
